snippet.title: Scorching Light • A Game Boy Horror Platformer indie homebrew game • Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#gameboy #retrogaming #indiegame 
Scorching Light is a horror-action-platformer Game Boy game with puzzle elements.

You play as an individual in a mission to find the light world, but hope soon became a nightmare. Hide from the light and blend into the environment to survive and find the truth.

■ Play now for free on... ■

🟧 Newgrounds.com (HTML5 Web browser, no download necessary) https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/1042733

🟥 Itch.io (HTML5 Web browser, no download necessary; Windows PC; Game Boy ROM)
https://pasquiindustry.itch.io/scorching-light

🟢 Microsoft Xbox Store (Xbox PC; Xbox One; Xbox Series X|S)
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/scorching-light/9NDT62V5VPP8

You can play with keyboard, gamepad or touch screen.

■  More info ■ 

This is a real original Game Boy game made with GB Studio. You can download the ROM for free and play on real hardware, from the Game Boy to the Analogue Pocket

I made this game as a solo developer in just a week (With a day job) for the Newgrounds Summer Game Jam 2026 with its theme "Hidden".

This is my second ever Game Boy game. My first game was Dorotea: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tn_YQ7gnrPw 

I didn't use AI to make this game. 

■  Listen to the OST here ■ 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OKpZjDeDOtg
